experiment: fdu --watch resident-monitor soak on the busiest agent-state root (~476k entries: 377,273 files/symlinks/others + 98,401 dirs; 40.4 GB allocated), 2026-09-27, macOS 26.5 APFS internal volume, loaded M-series host (load1 7-51, median 15)
binary: the installed fdu 0.1.0-dev (Python-package CLI, native extension in-process, notify 8.2.0 FSEvents backend); cache on the external volume; --interval 10s; --view files --format jsonl --full
method: W = watcher's last throttled persisted snapshot (copied aside, read back with --cache only) sandwiched between two fresh --cache off walks O1 and O2; W reconstructed from the stream (W0 + 6,182 change records) matched the persisted W on all 377,273 non-directory entries

accuracy.why_accurate: every FSEvents ItemRenamed (61.5% of raw events here) is an unpaired rename to notify/fdu and escalates to a whole-root reconciliation; the watcher ran one every ~20 s for the whole hour, so it was effectively a full-tree poller and re-stat'd held-open files as a side effect

startup.phases_from_rss_cpu_samples: parallel cold scan ~7 s (CPU 21.5 s), snapshot save ~4 s, serial revalidation walk ~37 s, JSON render of 225 MB initial files view ~10 s
startup.lock: timing lock NOT held at start (queue >5 min); host load ~25

persistence.note: full 36.8 MB snapshot rewrite (77 B/entry) after nearly every reconcile: 6.9 GB written in the hour

steady_state.fseventsd_note: not attributable: other agents ran FSEvents history replays concurrently (per-30 s median 0.72 s, spikes to 23 s)

counterfactual_event_only_watcher.interpretation: without the rename-triggered root reconciles, in-place growth (99.8% of it in held-open session logs and SQLite/WAL files) would be invisible until close; re-stat of the ~70 enumerated open files (45 ms median) recovers all of it

growth_W0_to_O2.note: gross growth 120.8 MB (new files 1,578 mostly .pyc/.py under project worktrees inside the root, plus session .jsonl and SQLite growth) against 178.6 MB shrink/removal; 56% of gross growth and 99.8% of in-place growth was in files held open

extrapolation.basis: per-entry costs from this 476k-entry root: resident index ~190 B/entry (116 MB min RSS incl. 26 MB wrapper), reconcile transients push RSS to ~440 MB median / 837 MB peak (~0.9-1.8 KB/entry); reconcile 9.9 CPU s per pass = 21 us/entry (sys-heavy: 64% sys); snapshot 77 B/entry rewritten per persist

1.5M_entries.verdict: one rename every 20 s keeps a core >100% busy; the watcher falls behind

5M_entries.verdict: unusable as designed; needs paired renames (or subtree-scoped escalation) and incremental persistence before any resident mode

extrapolation.event_only_cost_if_root_escalation_were_: measured 0.25-0.37 CPU s per 30 s (~1% of a core) in windows with no root reconcile at 326 raw events/min; RSS would sit at the index floor
